subheadline: From single relaunches to multi-brand platforms, the package is the same. The Agency plan costs €149 a month and covers unlimited projects.

items.title: Agencies
items.description: Use the same 244 audited elements for every client. The Agency plan covers unlimited projects and gives you direct contact with the maintainers.

items.title: In-house teams
items.description: Editors build landing pages in the content wizard instead of filing developer tickets, and every section stays on brand.

items.title: Relaunches
items.description: Start from a seeded styleguide on the first day. Then adjust theme presets until the site matches the brand.

items.title: Multi-brand sites
items.description: Per-page theme presets give each brand section its own look. One TYPO3 installation serves several brands without a multi-site setup.

items.title: Editorial portals
items.description: Combine the Content & Editorial group with the News and blog integrations. Sites that publish a lot use the same tokens.

items.title: Lead generation sites
items.description: The Leads & Conversion group has 8 ready forms, Friendly Captcha and the Brevo double opt-in finisher to turn visitors into leads.
